title: U-Con 2018 Set 1: Knights, Necromancer, Rogue, Feodum, Hermit

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Michigan U-Con 2018 Tournament Summary; Set 2018-1, Horton played and won

quality_note: Horton's first-person report of a 3P game he won; he credits a lucky Knight trade, so the plan is lightly supported.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule (U-Con): players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. 3-player game. Shepherd's Heirloom: each player starts with Pasture in place of one Copper. Played with the 2018-2019 Hermit wording: when you discard it from play, if you didn't buy any cards this turn, trash it and gain a Madman (it is trashed, so trash triggers fire).

edition: 2018 rules: pre-errata Hermit (trashes itself for Madman).
